representations.name: One-sided CRT box and successor after 2k
representations.new_information: Keeps the exact box A_p={0,-1,...,-(p-k-1)} and the order of its CRT image in [0,P_k).
representations.repairs_loss: Does not replace the initial prefix by a random translate or by scalar density.
representations.first_test: Enumerate exact small CRT boxes, their successor after 2k, maximum gap, and translated successors; compare with 1/D_k.
representations.closure_interface: An exp(o(k)) upper bound for the first CRT-box representative strictly after 2k closes the requested upper half; a bound for the least positive point does not, because the box has trivial points in (k,2k].

representations.name: Forward simultaneous multiple windows
representations.new_information: Represents admissibility as the existence, for every p, of p|n+s_p with 0<=s_p<p-k.
representations.repairs_loss: Exposes the common left endpoint n and the prime-dependent one-sided window width.
representations.first_test: For exact first representatives, record offsets s_p and quotients (n+s_p)/p and test whether a low-complexity quotient law or shared factor explains them.
representations.closure_interface: A construction of simultaneous forward multiples with n<=exp(o(k)) proves the target directly.

representations.name: Orthant lattice
representations.new_information: Embeds (n,s_p) in the lattice n+s_p=p a_p and retains the signs 0<=s_p<p-k as an orthant constraint.
representations.repairs_loss: Makes explicit the sign information erased by symmetric Dirichlet approximation.
representations.first_test: Find the shortest symmetric recurrence and shortest one-sided recurrence in exact small systems; measure their ratio and construct sign-obstruction examples.
representations.closure_interface: An orthant-sensitive lattice-point bound producing 2k<n<=exp(O(m log log k)) would imply exp(o(k)); merely producing a positive lattice point can return a trivial interval prime n<=2k.

representations.name: Local Fourier product with support ledger
representations.new_information: Factors the exact Fourier transform into interval coefficients while recording the number of active prime frequencies in every character.
representations.repairs_loss: Retains pointwise prefix phases rather than only pair correlations averaged over translations.
representations.first_test: Compute the exact Fourier prefix decomposition for small squarefree systems and separate low-support, high-support, and near-zero-frequency contributions.
representations.closure_interface: A pointwise error O(exp(O(m log log k))) below the main count H D_k would prove exp(o(k)).

representations.name: Block-CRT meet in the middle
representations.new_information: Groups primes into product moduli and studies the additive incidence that makes two block solutions combine to a small global CRT representative.
representations.repairs_loss: Preserves the actual representative during CRT composition instead of multiplying all block periods blindly.
representations.first_test: For small systems split primes in every balanced way and compare the minimum combined representative with block densities and additive energies.
representations.closure_interface: A two-block small-incidence theorem iterated over O(1/epsilon) blocks could yield exp(epsilon k).

representations.name: Coverage-depth moment problem
representations.new_information: Uses C_k(n)=#{p:n mod p in [1,k]} and asks whether its truncated moments force mass at C_k=0.
representations.repairs_loss: Quantifies exactly which high-order correlations a lower-bound sieve would need.
representations.first_test: Solve the finite truncated moment linear program and evaluate Bonferroni polynomials on the independent half-density comparator.
representations.closure_interface: A low-degree polynomial minorant for 1_{C=0} with controllable CRT moment errors would prove a positive prefix count.

representations.name: Ordered covering-system dual
representations.new_information: Treats n_k>H as a cover of the fixed ordered interval (2k,H] by aligned length-k blocks modulo distinct primes.
representations.repairs_loss: Retains endpoints, run lengths, and the common phase 1 of every forbidden block.
representations.first_test: Extract exact covers for small k, compute indispensable witnesses and boundary transition counts, and compare with translated phases.
representations.closure_interface: A compression or dual certificate that every such cover has description length at least log H would bound the initial covered run.

representations.name: Quotient-stable multiscale blocks
representations.new_information: Partitions n by the vectors floor(n/p), whose changes occur at actual prime multiples and therefore retain position.
representations.repairs_loss: Turns the initial prefix into a deterministic boundary recursion rather than a translation average.
representations.first_test: Compute block sizes and child-boundary counts over exact prefixes; kill contraction claims when exceptional boundary mass does not decrease.
representations.closure_interface: A recursion with exp(O(m log log k)) total boundary states would imply exp(o(k)).

representations.name: Common-endpoint monotone CRT sumset
representations.new_information: Writes the allowed CRT image as the sum of intervals along CRT idempotents, all anchored at residue zero, and distinguishes it from arbitrary equal-density subsets.
representations.repairs_loss: Preserves the aligned endpoint that generic density counterexamples destroy.
representations.first_test: Compute iterated sumsets, difference sets, longest monotone chains, maximum cyclic gaps, and the successor after 2k on small systems; reject least-positive surrogates because interval primes give trivial points below 2k.
representations.closure_interface: A successor-after-2k or maximum-gap theorem for anchored CRT interval sumsets would locate n_k; a least-positive-element theorem is insufficient.

representations.name: Near-k prime absorption plus widened boxes
representations.new_information: Pays exp(delta) to make primes in (k,k+delta) divide n, leaving widths at least delta for all remaining constraints.
representations.repairs_loss: Separates the few narrow one-sided coordinates that dominate Fourier and lattice condition numbers.
representations.first_test: Optimize delta on exact systems and test whether the first representative among multiples of the absorbed-prime product falls by more than the absorption cost.
representations.closure_interface: With delta=k/log k, a widened-box first-representative bound (C log k)^m would be exp(o(k)).
